player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id} long Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
Simbol bilong yu '{symbol}', na namba bilong move bilong yu em i oltaim {parity} (olsem, X1, X3 o O2, O4).

Gol: Winim long mekim lain bilong tripela mak klassikal (solidified from superpositions).

Hau bilong Pley:
- Long kila raun, putim mak spooky long tupela skwea difren long usim format '[a,b]'.
- Mak bilong yu em i entangled, na labelim olsem 'X1 / X1' o 'O4 / O4'.
- Yu no inap putim mak spooky long skwea we i kisim pinis (solidified).

Rul bilong Collapse:
- Sapos move bilong yu i mekim siklus long graf bilong entanglement, em i collapse otomatik.
- Kila mak spooky long siklus em i tanim long mak klassikal long wanpela posisen bilong em.
- Mak spooky bilong dependent em i collapse tu.

Viktori:
- Gem i pinis taim wanpela player i gat tripela mak klassikal long lain.
- Sapos tupela player i gat lain long taim wankain collapse, wanpela i gat namba move max i win.

Eg bilong move: '[0,4]' i putim mak spooky long sel 0 na 4.

invalid_move.invalid_cells: Ol i no stret o ol sel bilong en i wankain.
invalid_move.already_solidified: Wanpela sel i kamap strong pinis.

game_action.placed: Pleeya {player_id} putim simbol bilong em long superposition bilong sel {pos_a} na {pos_b}.

game_message.dependent_resolved: Dependent superposition i kamap klia. Sel ({r}, {c}) nau i {symbol}.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Superposition bilong last sel i kamap klia. Sel ({r}, {c}) nau i {symbol}.
game_message.superposition_resolved: Superposition i kamap klia. Sel ({r}, {c}) nau i {symbol}.

outcome.win: Man i gat mak {player_id} em bai winim!
